headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 31, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays suffered a tough loss to the Baltimore Orioles, who took the game 5-9. Colton Cowser led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. In another game, the Washington Nationals secured a 2-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Konnor Griffin of the Pittsburgh Pirates, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right elbow strain. Bailey Ober of the Minnesota Twins has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. Craig Kimbrel of the Tampa Bay Rays has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 28, 2026, with a right wrist strain.

The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade. Vasquez joins the Tigers after being dealt from the Toronto Blue Jays.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Fall to Orioles in 5-9 Thrashing**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays suffered a tough loss to the Baltimore Orioles, who took the game 5-9. Colton Cowser led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 2-4 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 2-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with a home run and two RBIs. Zack Littell earned the win for the Nationals, pitching 6.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Twins 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Minnesota Twins, winning 9-3 behind a strong performance from Braxton Ashcraft. Brooks Lee led the Twins' offense with two home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Rally Past Guardians 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 9-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jovani Morán earning the win. Jarren Duran led the Red Sox offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Griffin on Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have placed shortstop Konnor Griffin on the 10-day injured list due to a right elbow strain. Griffin's status is now uncertain as he begins his recovery.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade. Vasquez joins the Tigers after being dealt from the Toronto Blue Jays.
